rows.label: qst620204_msg0001
rows.name:
That monster must have been starving
to come out even with us here.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0002
rows.name:
Maybe the vegetables were so tasty it
could not resist.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0003
rows.name:
They are my prized Stamin-Nass, after
all.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0005
rows.name:
Until just now, I thought you three
might not get along...

rows.label: qst620204_msg0006
rows.name:
But you fought wonderfully when you
joined forces.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0008
rows.name:
This man and Tokiha are both excellent
Blades. It is only natural...

rows.label: qst620204_msg0009
rows.name:
I still believe I have much training
ahead of me...

rows.label: qst620204_msg0010
rows.name:
Now, now. In any case, I am grateful
to you three.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0012
rows.name:
I also need to restore this field. If
you have time, give me a hand.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0013
rows.name:
I'll pay you properly, just like this
time.

rows.label: qst620204_msg0014
rows.name: That kind of work sounds fun too!

rows.label: qst620204_msg0017
rows.name: I'm counting on all three of you.
